title: Utsuro na Ryōriten
tagline: The Hollow Restaurant and the Orchestra of Whispering Beasts
summary: Deep within a mist-shrouded cedar forest, a ruined Western-style restaurant hums with a phantom orchestra and sweet chimney smoke. A lost girl carrying a taro leaf steps inside, only to be welcomed by mute animal yokai who serve an endless, suffocatingly sweet feast.
